## Introduction

Large vision-language models (LVLMs) (OpenAI, 2024; Anthropic, 2024a; Team et al., 2023; Wang et al., 2024f) represent a pivotal breakthrough in artificial intelligence and signal a transformative approach to multimodal understanding and interaction. By integrating visual perception with natural language processing, these models are reshaping how machines interpret and analyze complex information across diverse domains.

Despite these advances, current multimodal large language models resemble the middle layer of a sandwich cookie: competent across many tasks but rarely exceptional. The top layer of this framework is multimodal reasoning, which we strengthen by building on the latest Qwen2.5 LLM and by constructing multimodal QA data.

A range of studies has advanced multimodal large models through architectural design, visual input processing, and data curation. Continuous innovation in architecture is a primary driver of progress in LVLMs. The studies in (Alayrac et al., 2022; Li et al., 2022a; Li et al., 2023b; Liu et al., 2023b; Liu et al., 2023a; Wang et al., 2024i; Zhang et al., 2024b; Wang et al., 2023) have incrementally shaped the current paradigm, which typically consists of a visual encoder, a cross-modal projector, and a large language model (LLM). The architectures of Omni systems (Li et al., 2024g; Li et al., 2025b; Ye et al., 2024) and mixture-of-experts (MoE) models (Riquelme et al., 2021; Lee et al., 2024; Li et al., 2024h; Li et al., 2024c; Wu et al., 2024b) also inform the future evolution of LVLMs. Improvements in visual encoders (Chen et al., 2023; Liu et al., 2024b; Liang et al., 2025) and in resolution scaling (Li et al., 2023c; Ye et al., 2023; Li et al., 2023a) have improved the quality of practical visual understanding. - "long history, a rigorous academic atmosphere and a very good reputation"、"I have read the website"、"interested in… machine learning, data mining and software engineering"——这三句可以原封不动投给任何学校，是典型的模板凑数，评审最反感。
- 没有提到**任何一位教授、实验室或具体课程/论文**，没有任何"匹配"论证。
- 职业规划"come back to China **or** work in a technology company"含糊且不表态，显得你自己都没想清楚。
- 结尾"precious opportunity"+"I will not let you down"是乞求式收尾，姿态太低、没有力量。

**怎么改**
- 点名 **1–2 位教授 / 一个实验室 / 一门课**，说清你的经历和他们的研究**具体怎么对接**（哪怕引用他们一篇论文的一个点）。
- 职业目标给一个明确方向（例如"做工业级推荐/搜索系统"），不要用 or 二选一。
- 结尾自信、简洁，表达你能带来什么，而不是"求求你给我机会"。

**示例**
> 原句 "I am very interested in the research directions of your professors, such as machine learning, data mining and software engineering."
> 改为："I am particularly drawn to Prof. ___'s work on scalable recommendation, whose cold-start approach directly extends the problem I hit in my own project; I would like to build on that line of research in your lab."
